Method of Attack: Missing authentication bug exploited to execute arbitrary code via the job submission API
Unauthorized actors submitting jobs, deleting existing jobs, retrieving sensitive information, and achieving remote command execution
Impacted Systems: Cloud environments from Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure
Attack Vector: Exploitation of missing authentication controls in Ray components (Dashboard and Client)
Remote command execution via job submission API
Indicators of Compromise: Access tokens related to OpenAI, HuggingFace, Slack, and Stripe
Cryptocurrency miners (e.g., XMRig, NBMiner, and Zephyr)
Reverse shells for persistent remote access
